items.title: Choose the right streaming ingestion path for Apache Iceberg tables on AWS
items.summary: Choosing the right streaming ingestion path for Apache Iceberg tables shapes your data lake's latency, cost, and capabilities. This post compares five AWS paths against eight technical criteria and closes with a decision framework you can apply to your own workload.
items.creator: Mazrim Mehrtens
categories: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
